themes.evidence: Charles Schwab was awarded "Highest in Investor Satisfaction with Full Service Brokerage Firms, Two Years in a Row" by J.D. Power.

Selected as one of the FORTUNE “World’s Most Admired Companies®”, Schwab ranked #1 for Innovation and #2 for Social Responsibility in Key Attributes of Reputation and #2 in the Securities and Asset Management category.

Schwab was named #1 in Customer Service and Trade Reliability in the 2017 Investor’s Business Daily “Best Online Brokers” Survey for the fifth year in a row. Schwab also received the highest rating for website performance for the second consecutive year.

linguistic_shift: The page emphasizes customer satisfaction and innovation more than prior years, with a focus on specific awards and rankings.
